content.text:
All five phases are finished and pushed, each on its own branch with a tag. They're stacked, so `compaction-phase5` contains everything. `main` is unchanged: it still sits at `compaction-baseline`, and nothing is merged yet.

| Tag | What changed |
|---|---|
| `compaction-v1` | The pruner never trims the newest 5 tool results and only trims when it frees at least 20,000 tokens. Trimmed text is saved to a file whose path is in the marker. On overflow it trims everything oversized. |
| `compaction-v2` | The summary prompt now keeps every user message word for word and preserves security constraints exactly. "Next Step" includes a verbatim quote of where the work stopped, and there are explicit rules for merging an earlier summary. |
| `compaction-v3` | After compaction, the checkpoint names a saved plain-text transcript of what was summarized. Up to 5 recently read files are re-read and attached (5,000 tokens each, 50,000 total). It never grows past the size of what it replaces. |
| `compaction-v4` | If the context refills within 3 steps of a compaction, 3 times in a row, the turn stops with an error naming the likely oversized file or output. |
| `compaction-v5` | Outputs over 50 KB now leave a 2 KB preview plus the file path instead of about 50 KB of preview (roughly 500 tokens instead of 12,500). |

**One change from the original plan:** Phase 5 was meant to lower the 50 KB spill threshold. Claude Code's binary shows the same 50,000-character cap, so there was no evidence for a different number. The real gap was the preview size, so I changed that instead.

**The default numbers come from Claude Code and opencode, not from measurements on this harness.** They're all settings you can change.

**Checks run for every phase:**
- all 223 compaction tests and the `spill-policy` tests, with 100% coverage of the changed code;
- lint;
- the full typecheck including tests;
- the relevant documentation checks.

**Not verified:**
- No live model session has exercised any of this end to end.
- The `bash-spill` recorded snapshot can't run on Windows because the `bash` tool doesn't exist here. I confirmed it isn't affected by the preview change.
- 3 `spill-local` tests fail because Windows won't create symlinks without Developer Mode.
- I didn't run the full test suite, the browser snapshots or the real-API tests.

**Still broken on `main` (my doing):** the engine book I pushed earlier fails 4 documentation checks.

To compare everything, run `git diff compaction-baseline..compaction-v5 -- packages/compaction packages/spill`, or open `https://github.com/poojarishreyas/Elemental_harness/compare/compaction-baseline...compaction-v5`. Should I merge `compaction-phase5` into `main` (or open a PR), and fix the engine-book checks?
